title: Microbial Community from a Plumbing-Based Bioelectrochemical Sensor
description: This project studies the microbial community associated with the electrodes biofilm of a plumbing-based bioelectrochemical sensor. The electrodes biofllms were collected after long-term operations of the sensor and subjected to 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing to characterize the microbial composition and diversity involved.
samples: Natural source microbial inoculum used for bioelectrochemical sensor enrichment
Malaysia: Faculty of Engineering and Built Environment, UKM, Bangi
Natural water/sediment inoculum used for bioelectrochemical sensor enrichment
environmental sample; urban association not established
